verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a video platform that ships client SDKs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions any setting to disable telemetry, usage tracking or SDK logging. The session-monitoring docs describe developers receiving client activity callbacks, which is a different feature from opting out of tracking and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
